d:
Glenn Maxwell, popularly known as 'The Big Show', has announced his retirement from international cricket, bringing an end to a remarkable chapter in Australian cricket history.
From his unconventional batting style and the phenomenon of 'Maxwellball' to some of the most unbelievable innings in cricket, Maxwell redefined what was possible on a cricket field.
In this video, we look back at Glenn Maxwell's incredible journey — his early struggles, rise in international cricket, the origin of his famous nicknames, his mental health break, injury struggles and remarkable comebacks.
